acquisition_method.evidence: Data was acquired in data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode, using a Top10 method.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Lysates were incubated at 96 °C for 5 min, followed by six cycles of 30 s of sonication (Bioruptor Pico, Diagenode, USA). Protein concentration was measured using the BCA assay (Thermo Scientific, USA) and a total of 120 μg protein was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol and alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were then digested with trypsin (1:50 trypsin/protein) for 1.5 h at 47 °C.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptides were enriched from the total protein digest using a ProPac IMAC-10 column (4 × 50 mm) (Thermo Scientific, P.N. 063276).

instrument.evidence: The nanoUPLC was coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA) to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive HFX, Thermo Scientific) using a FlexIon nanospray apparatus (Proxeon).
